look.why: A cool North Pacific kelp-forest teal that evokes coastal waters and complements the warm chocolate-brown fur.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 1.3 m (total length 1–1.5 m including 25–35 cm tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Shallow coastal kelp forests and rocky reefs along the northern Pacific Ocean.

diet.text: Sea urchins, abalones, clams, mussels, crabs and sea stars cracked open on its chest using a flat stone.

facts.text: It has the densest fur of any animal—up to 150,000 hairs per square centimeter—trapping air instead of blubber for warmth.
Sea otters wrap themselves in kelp fronds while sleeping at sea so they do not drift away.

id.habitat: Hutan rumput laut (kelp) pesisir yang dangkal dan terumbu berbatu di Samudra Pasifik bagian utara.
id.diet: Bulu babi, abalon, kerang, remis, kepiting, dan bintang laut yang dipecahkan di dadanya memakai batu.
facts: Memiliki bulu terlebat dari semua hewan—hingga 150.000 helai per sentimeter persegi—untuk menahan panas tubuh tanpa lapisan lemak tebal.
Berang-berang laut melilitkan tubuhnya dengan daun kelp saat tidur di laut agar tidak hanyut terbawa arus.
